x: ALBERT MACHER, JACK MACHER and JACK FLOWER were collectively in our thoughts during that minute of remembrance; and sharing that moment too was JACK HARTLEY of Coventry Godiva, guest at our last dinner in his capacity as ECCU President, and whose loss is mourned by the Midland club and its neighbours.
